        x86_user_map_kernel_start_bridge(),
        X86_KERNEL_PHYS_BASE,
        LINUX_PAGE_OFFSET_BASE,
        MAP_FIXED_START,
        MAP_ST_START,
        Some(x86_addr_log_bridge),
    )
}
